payload.summary: The agenda page for the Licensing committee meeting held on 5 March 2026 at 4.30pm in the Mancroft room at City Hall. Item 4 was the draft Statement of Licensing Policy, and its stated purpose was to consider the revised draft and recommend it to Cabinet for a 12-week consultation. Seven councillors attended, three sent apologies and two were absent. The page links the officer's report, three appendices and the minutes of the meeting.
